reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low and I always forget pills at home, so a sachet I can toss in my bag is exactly what I'd actually take. The lab report and the money-back thing make $24.99 a low-risk try.
objection: It's only one form of magnesium, and other brands put 8 forms in one capsule. I'm not sure bisglycinate alone is enough, and $29.99 a month is real money on my budget once the launch price ends.
would_change_my_mind: If the price after the launch deal stayed closer to $25, or if the lab report showed the amount matches the label exactly. If it were only one box at $29.99 with no lab report, I'd skip it.
